stable.notes: Desktop 2.2.0 adds a Vacancy Dashboard and Applications history. It shows score, position, company, decision and status; provides job details, Open job, Apply manually, REVIEW, Interesting, Skip and cover-letter actions; stores richer vacancy snapshots locally; and lets REVIEW/SKIP overrides affect future runs while final employer submission remains manual.
